appDescription: Pleorder simulates food delivery to home and food pickup on the driving route. All orders, restaurants, couriers and payments are simulated. It prepares a draft before explicit confirmation.

function.name: PREPARE_FOOD_ORDER
function.description: Prepare a simulated food order for delivery or pickup. Never submits an order. Read back the draft ID, meal, quantity, fulfillment and total, then ask the user to confirm.

query.description: Meal or restaurant requested by the user, such as 비빔밥, 국밥, 치킨, 버거, 샐러드 or 라멘.

fulfillment.description: delivery sends food to the demo home; pickup collects it at the simulated restaurant.

timing.description: soon prepares now; arrival schedules simulated delivery around the driver's home arrival.

function.name: CONFIRM_FOOD_ORDER
function.description: Confirm the current simulated draft only after the user explicitly agrees to the read-back details. Copy the draftId from PREPARE_FOOD_ORDER. A changed or expired draft needs a fresh confirmation.

draftId.description: Exact current draft ID returned by PREPARE_FOOD_ORDER.

confirmation.description: True only when the user explicitly confirmed the current order details.

function.name: GET_FOOD_ORDER_STATUS
function.description: Get the current simulated food delivery or pickup status and remaining preparation or delivery information.
